reviewerText: The project states: "Snapshots are written periodically." and p2 says so.
An environment file is not part of the idea.
The span is excluded, so its bytes are not in the packet.
The second sentence overreaches a little.
holderTexts: {"command":"review-packet","outcome":"built","run":"/tmp/r559-m-p1/dossier-review-state-uWa7UR/run-eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee","kind":"fidelity","packetSha256":"f3c4d04b01c23c3e7cda9dcfc628bebe1c108d7671fe6ecee4e4f0eb3cfc86c3","directory":"/tmp/r559-m-p1/dossier-review-state-uWa7UR/run-eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee/reviews/fidelity-packet-f3c4d04b01c23c3e7cda9dcfc628bebe1c108d7671fe6ecee4e4f0eb3cfc86c3","draftRevision":0,"inventoryRevision":0,"spans":{"admitted":4,"excluded":1},"label":"Observed","disclosures":["the consent, registry, policy and statement records the gates read lie in Syzygy's checkout, which the agent sessions can write; Syzygy re-reads and re-checks them at every step, and cannot rule out that a session changed them","Syzygy built this packet at this step from the frozen draft, the inventory of record and Git objects read by identifier at the pinned revision and re-hashed now; the packet and its digest are Observed at this step.","The emitted packet lies within the agent sessions' write reach, so that the review session read it unaltered is Inferred; the digest beside it lets the session re-hash it, a cheap check, not a proof.","The inventory's completeness is Inferred: the inventory's completeness over the clone and its preparation from the whole source population, which are the inventory session's self-report and never verified.","The content-class gate covers only the spans Syzygy read: a span whose class the run's statement does not list carries no byte, but the draft and the inventory the packet carries are the agents' own text and may quote that span verbatim."]}
